verdict.rationale: Cline generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own data, meaning their codebase and changes. Plan mode reads the codebase and discusses strategy, subagents explore the code and return detailed reports, and piped diffs can be reviewed. External data sources can be reached through MCP. The evidence covers code-centric analysis only, not broader data insights surfaced proactively in the product. Missing for 10: proactive or surfaced insights beyond chat-driven requests, analysis of non-code data documented in depth, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy, but cannot modify any files or execute commands.
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers.
